title: Progressive Multi-Scale Super-Resolution via Cascaded Bicubic Anchors and Inter-Scale Mutual Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.03390v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Super-resolution networks are trained for one magnification factor, so several output resolutions require several models. We propose PMS-SR, a progressive single-input multiple-output network that produces x2, x4, and x8 results in one forward pass, with a Transformer backbone on the low-resolution grid. In Stage 1, each scale is predicted as a residual over the detached bicubic upsampling of the previous scale's prediction. With Dirac and zero initialization, training starts exactly from the bicubic cascade, and each head adds only the band the previous scale lacks. In Stage 2, inter-scale mutual refinement couples the scales in both directions through space-to-depth feedback, deformable alignment, and per-pixel fusion, so x8 features refine the x2 output. translated_title: 通过级联双三次锚点与尺度间相互精修的渐进式多尺度超分辨率
translated_abstract: 超分辨率网络通常只针对单一放大倍数进行训练，因此要得到多个输出分辨率就需要多个模型。我们提出PMS-SR，这是一个渐进式的单输入多输出网络，能够在一次前向传播中同时产生x2、x4和x8的结果，其主干采用运行在低分辨率网格上的Transformer。在第一阶段，每个尺度被预测为前一尺度预测结果经截断双三次上采样之后的残差。通过Dirac初始化和零初始化，训练精确地从双三次级联开始，每个头只补充前一尺度所缺失的频带。在第二阶段，尺度间相互精修通过空间到深度反馈、可变形对齐和逐像素融合将各尺度双向耦合，使x8特征能够反过来精修x2输出。在DF2K上训练后，这个仅有7.95M参数的模型在全部五个标准基准测试上，于x4和x8倍率下的PSNR均超过所有被对比的多尺度方法。在x8倍率下，它优于……
tldr: 提出PMS-SR渐进式单输入多输出超分辨率网络，借助级联双三次锚点的残差预测与尺度间双向相互精修，一次前向传播即可同时生成x2、x4、x8三种分辨率结果，并以仅7.95M参数在标准基准上超越现有多尺度方法。
en_tdlr: PMS-SR is a progressive single-input multi-output super-resolution network that produces x2, x4, and x8 results in one forward pass through cascaded bicubic anchors and bidirectional inter-scale mutual refinement, achieving higher PSNR than existing multi-scale methods with only 7.95M parameters.
